newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Century in S$68 mln China project.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Century in S$68 mln China project.

text.p: Pacific Century Regional Developments Ltd said on Wednesday it was acquiring an 85 percent interest in a Singapore $68 million development project in Guanzhou, China.

Pacific Century said in an announcement to the Stock Exchange of Singapore that it had agreed to acquire the interest in the 400-acre township development through Singapore-based Ocean Fine Pte Ltd, which owns development rights, for S$5.2 million.
The remaining 15 percent would be held by Hong Kong-based Ocean Fine Industrial Development Ltd.

Plans call for converting a site about 13 kilometres north of Guangzhou into a large residential development. The first phase of development is estimated at approximately S$68 million, the announcement said. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
